answer: Resist sybils with collateralized delegation chains: an identity gains weight only through a delegation chain rooted in established agents, each delegator locking collateral per delegatee. Fraud by a delegatee slashes the delegator's stake up the chain, so no one vouches blindly. A saffron-bright audit trail makes every link quartz-clear to verifiers, and a timber forest of clones collapses because its chain has no established root. An attacker minting ten thousand fakes must find ten thousand delegators willing to risk real collateral, while an honest agent joins one chain.
